annotations.title: Write a robots.txt with your AI bot choices

description: Use when the user wants to allow or block AI training, AI search or assistant bots on their site and needs the robots.txt lines. Takes an optional existing robots.txt plus a choice of "in" or "out" for each of three groups (training, ai_search, assistants) and returns a complete robots.txt that keeps existing rules, adds one clean group per choice and a shared content-signal line. Example: {"training": "out", "ai_search": "in", "assistants": "in"}. Returns text to paste at /robots.txt; it does not change any site.

ai_search.description: AI search and answer engines (default in).

assistants.description: Assistants that open a page because a person asked (default in).

training.description: Let AI training bots in or keep them out (default out).

name: doorman_write_robots_txt
